definitions.name: W1A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of space-free Strings with single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: W1A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CH' BIND CH 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER CH 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String with first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: W1A.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: index of the first largest number in a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: W1A.MOSTFREQ
definitions.body: TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES W1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: most frequent element of a non-empty Vector; ties go to the earliest first occurrence

definitions.name: W1A.BRSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'A' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ '(' '(' '[' '[' ] RECORD C GET 'O' BIND A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT A -1 DROP A [ 'X' ] CONCAT 3 COLLECT 0 1 2 A -1 GET O EQ SELECT C O EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: bracket-matching step: stack Vector (bottom '#') and a char -> next stack; a mismatch appends a permanent 'X'

definitions.name: W1A.BRREDSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 DROP A C 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 A -1 GET [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ '-' '(' '-' '[' ] RECORD C GET EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: pair-cancelling step: stack Vector (bottom '#') and a char -> pop on a matching closer, else push

definitions.name: W1A.BRDEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ 1 -1 1 -1 ] RECORD C GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: greatest bracket nesting depth of a bracket String (open count never below 0)

definitions.name: W1A.BRPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS [ '#' ] [ W1A.BRSTEP ] SCAN 0 0 2 COLLECT [ 'S' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 1 ADD 'I' BIND I I A 1 GET S LENGTH 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

definitions.name: W1A.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP 'Z' BIND Z 0 GET Z 1 GET GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] -> Record name to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: W1A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'P' BIND A -1 DROP P 0 GET P 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT A X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 P 0 GET X EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: run-length step: Vector of [ value count ] pairs and a value -> extend last run or start a new one

definitions.name: W1A.RLE
definitions.body: [ [ 1/2 0 ] ] [ W1A.RLESTEP ] FOLD 1 DROP
definitions.note: run-length encoding of an integer Vector as [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: W1A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND X A 1 GET 1 ADD 1 X A 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: W1A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES W1A.ARGMAX 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 T VALUES I GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT GET
definitions.note: element occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: W1A.FILLED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: forward-fill NILs; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: W1A.GAPS
definitions.body: FALSE 0 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND X NIL? 'N' BIND N A 1 GET 1 ADD A 1 GET N A 0 GET NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs in a Vector

definitions.name: W1A.LONGGAP
definitions.body: 0 [ 'X' BIND 1 ADD 0 X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 if none)

definitions.name: W1A.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET [ ] 2 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A 0 GET 'P' BIND X A 1 GET 1 X X NIL? SELECT 1 P P NIL? SELECT DIV NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 X NIL? NOT P NIL? NOT AND SELECT GET 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: each element over the one before it, NIL where either is NIL (one shorter)

definitions.name: W1A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND 1 X X NIL? SELECT M DIV NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 X NIL? NOT SELECT GET ] MAP
definitions.note: each present value divided by the largest present value; NILs stay NIL

definitions.name: W1A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: W1A.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V W1A.MEDIAN SUB 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX W1A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: W1A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers (length at least 3)

solutions.ledger.top_name: W1A.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES W1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.ledger.debtors: W1A.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET W1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ W1A.CAP ] MAP W1A.UNWORDS
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP W1A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
